notes: Annotation depth: CORE — 12 core services + plan-level + appeals_contact. Long tail of services NOT annotated. Full-depth Blue Shield bundled-PDF stress test lives in blue-shield-ca-2025-silver-70-ppo.

Bundled PDF: 190 total pages. SBC content occupies pages 1-8 (footer 'X of 9' suggests a 9th SBC page that may be a back cover; not located in current scan). Page 9 begins the bundled Evidence of Coverage (EOC) document — 'Small Group Plan, Blue Shield Bronze 60 PPO 5800/60 PCP + Child Dental, Provider Network: Full PPO'. The bundled PDF may also include a child dental SBC and other appendices in pages 10-190. Parser must locate the SBC within this larger PDF — useful realism stress test.

Parser gap (not fixed in this PR): Insurer regex array in sbc-parser.ts has /blue\s*cross/ but NO /blue\s*shield/ pattern. Parser would emit insurer_name: null for this SBC. Ground truth annotated as 'Blue Shield of California' (legal entity name). Adding /blue\s*shield/ pattern AFTER /blue\s*cross/ in the patterns array would resolve this without affecting Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield matches.

Marketplace type: SHOP (Covered California Small Business). Distinct from Ambetter's individual marketplace. SHOP = small group employer; subject to ACA employer mandate; MVS applies (and SBC says 'Yes' to MVS).
MVS = 'Yes' (employer-style plan). Different from Ambetter's 'Not Applicable'. Reflects regulatory difference: SHOP plans are subject to employer-mandate Minimum Value Standard.
Coverage tier: 'Individual + Family' — parser regex maps this to 'individual_family'.
Coverage period uses 'Beginning On or After 1/1/2025' single-date format — relies on parser fix #2 from this PR.

Plan name on SBC header: 'Blue Shield Bronze 60 PPO 5800/60 PCP + Child Dental'. The '5800/60' encodes deductible/copay; 'PCP' indicates copay-based PCP visits; 'Child Dental' indicates pediatric dental embedded.
Specialist visit cost qualifier: 'First Dollar coverage applies' — meaning the $95 copay applies even before deductible, which I've encoded as in_deductible_applies: false.

Out-of-network coverage has multiple per-day benefit maximums ($350/day for outpatient hospital; $2,000/day for inpatient). Captured in coverage_conditions verbatim — these are per-day caps on the OON coinsurance, not annual limits.
Separate Rx deductible: $450 individual / $900 family. Annotated in `other_deductibles` JSONB.
Adult routine eye care is EXCLUDED on this SBC (different from Ambetter where it was 'Other Covered'). Captured in excluded_services_list.
excluded_services_list: non-emergency care when traveling outside the U.S.
